rationale: Motor vehicle collision with totaled vehicle and claimant sustaining whiplash and wrist sprain; clear auto damage claim.
claim_summary: Pat Morgan's vehicle was rear-ended on Route 9 at approximately 8:15 AM yesterday by another vehicle traveling 35 mph with no braking; the car is totaled with trunk crushed into the back seat. Claimant sustained whiplash and a sprained wrist. Other driver's insurance information is documented on the police report. This is a high-severity collision requiring immediate adjuster assignment.

case_facts.description: rear-ended by other vehicle traveling 35 mph, no braking, trunk crushed into back seat

rationale: The policyholder's own tree fell on their parked vehicle, causing damage to the hood and windshield; this is a classic comprehensive auto claim.
claim_summary: Riley Kim's maple tree fell in wind and struck their parked vehicle in the driveway, damaging the hood and windshield. This is a comprehensive auto claim under POL-1005 (bundle home/auto, $1,000 deductible, $400,000 limit). Estimated damage appears to be in the medium range.

case_facts.description: maple tree from own property fell in wind and struck parked car
